{{Top}}
The '''Senate Intelligence Oversight Committee''' was the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] council that oversaw the conduct of [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], they forbade the use of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] in investigations on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], but were overruled by [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].
